title: Food Spoilage and Preservation
summary: Why food goes bad, and how refrigeration, boiling, salting, sugaring, drying and pasteurisation stop microbes.

ib.note: Growth curves and exponential change link to MYP Maths

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe

objectives: I can explain food spoilage as the growth of microbes.
I can explain how common preservation methods stop or slow microbes.
I can choose suitable preservation methods for different foods.
misconceptions: Food is safe as long as it looks and smells fine.
